title: Origin story: Ravana
description: Ravana was the rakshasa king of Lanka, a Brahmin scholar who performed such austerities that Brahma granted him invulnerability to gods and demons — forgetting to include men. A master of the veena and the Vedas, his abduction of Sita was both his crime and his doom.

title: Ability profile: Ravana
description: Ranked abilities: Austerity — rank 99/100; Scholarship — rank 98/100; Combat — rank 97/100; Music — rank 96/100; Strategy — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Ravana
description: Powers: Ten heads — tenfold counsel; Twenty arms in battle; Boons making him nearly unkillable.

title: Stamina feats: Ravana
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Performed austerities for ten thousand years; Fought Rama to the last breath.

title: Crossover notes: Ravana
description: Ravana crosses naturally with: power, scholarship, music, hubris.

title: Cultural impact: Ravana
description: The brilliant villain; proof that learning without humility destroys.
